name: dsh-session-title-regenerate
description: Regenerate a session title with the model: summarize all of the session's user questions (UTF-8 truncated) through ctx.llm with purpose 'session-title', then commit via sessionTitle.rename so the list updates instantly. Defaults stay on the cheapest route — thinking off (reasoningEffort 'off', which the DeepSeek adapter additionally forces to thinking:disabled) with a 512-token output budget — and the plugin ships a Settings > 本地插件 tab (settings.localPlugins.tab, namespace 'session-title-regenerate') projected from its cordis entry Config, so the thinking switch, the reasoning tier when thinking is on (low/medium/high/max, shown as radio buttons; off is expressed by the switch itself) and the max output tokens are editable without touching the profile. Triggered from the session-header action button and from a DOM-injected '重新生成标题' item in the sidebar session-row '...' menu (core ui-workspace hard-codes that menu with no extension slot, so the item is injected at the DOM level like @huanlin/dsh-plugin-session-delete does). Host registers the /regenerate-title command; the client triggers it through remote.commands.execute, a core Remote whose agent lookup auto-resumes non-open sessions.
